---
name: release
description: Use when preparing a release handoff or evaluating readiness to release completed work.
---

# Release handoff

- Inspect the repository's versioning, changelog, and release conventions before recommending release steps.
- Summarize the candidate changes, proposed version when supported by project conventions, user-facing release notes, validation status, and outstanding blockers.
- Identify any required local release-preparation edits or commands, but only make those edits when explicitly in scope.
- Provide a clear checklist for the user's remaining actions, including any needed commit, push, tag, publication, deployment, or verification steps.
- Do not commit, push, create or push tags, publish packages, deploy, or create/edit any remote release or other GitHub resource.
